 SmackDown results, Nov. 20, 2026: Sami Zayn blindsides Kevin Owens with a Helluva Kick
 Moments after Finn Bálor helped Kevin Owens defeat Gunther, Undisputed WWE Champion stunned KO with a Helluva Kick. Plus, Jade Cargill took down Charlotte Flair to earn the WarGames Advantage for her team, "Hacksaw" Jim Duggan and United States Champion Trick Williams briefly joined Team USA and much more!

 Gunther confronted Kevin Owens 
 04:19 
 Gunther interrupts Kevin Owens’ address. Catch WWE action on the ESPN App, Netflix, USA Network, CW Network, Peacock, Rumble and more. 
 Jade Cargill def. Charlotte Flair in a WarGames Advantage Match 
 03:12 
 Charlotte Flair and Jade Cargill battle in a WarGames Advantage Match. Catch WWE action on the ESPN App, Netflix, USA Network, CW Network, Peacock, Rumble and more. 
 Charlotte Flair battled Jade Cargill in an important WarGames Advantage Match, with the rest of the field banned from ringside.
 Flair and Cargill traded Spears and Pump Kicks before Flair locked in the Figure-Four Leglock.  
 Cargill pulled the protective covering off the second turnbuckle, exposing it. Flair hit a Natural Selection but Cargill kicked out.  
 Cargill craftily shoved Flair into the exposed turnbuckle, before pinning Flair to win the match.
 The War Raiders def. Bakusai 
 03:09 
 Haku’s arrival helps The War Raiders gain a victory against Bakusai. Catch WWE action on the ESPN App, Netflix, USA Network, CW Network, Peacock, Rumble and more. 
 The bruising smash-mouth style of the War Raiders collided with the eccentric style of Bakusai.
 Kyoki used Ivar's own beard to bring him down, leveling him with a dropkick and an impressive ddt.
 Haku arrived, distracting Kyoki long enough for The War Raiders to take advantage. Ivar plowed through Kyoki with a spin kick to win the match.
 After the match, The MFTs attacked Erik, Ivar, Kyoki and Nakamura.
 Cody Rhodes and CM Punk tried to find a fifth member for Team USA 
 17:24 
 Cody Rhodes and CM Punk try to find a fifth Team USA member with “Hacksaw” Jim Duggan and Trick Williams entering the discussion. Catch WWE action on the ESPN App, Netflix, USA Network, CW Network, Peacock, Rumble and more. 
 Trick Williams def. Damian Priest via disqualification 
 03:17 
 Damian Priest damages United States Champion Trick Williams’ knee in a non-title match, taking Trick out of Survivor Series. Catch WWE action on the ESPN App, Netflix, USA Network, CW Network, Peacock, Rumble and more. 
 United States Champion Trick Williams faced Damian Priest in a non-title match.  
 Just as the match got going, Priest blasted Williams' knee with the ring bell, ended the match in a disqualification.
 Priest kept attacking Williams, leaving Trick in serious pain and Team USA in dire straits.
 Rey Fenix def. Kit Wilson 
 02:50 
 AAA Cruiserweight Champion Rey Fenix takes on Kit Wilson in a non-title match. Catch WWE action on the ESPN App, Netflix, USA Network, CW Network, Peacock, Rumble and more. 
 AAA Cruiserweight Champion Rey Fenix clashed with Kit Wilson in a non-title match.
 Despite a spirited effort from Wilson, Fenix connected with the Mexican Muscle Buster to win the match.  
 Kevin Owens def. Gunther 
 04:54 
 Kevin Owens collides with Gunther in a hard-hitting matchup. Catch WWE action on the ESPN App, Netflix, USA Network, CW Network, Peacock, Rumble and more. 
 After a confrontation earlier in the evening, Kevin Owens and Gunther went one-on-one.
 KO went for a Swanton Bomb but Gunther got his knees up.  
 KO went for a Stunner but in an echo from last week, The Ring General shoved Owens into the referee.
 Candice LeRae and Johnny Gargano tried to distract KO but it backfired as Owens hit a Pop-Up Powerbomb on Gargano. Gunther tried to take advantage but was thwarted by Finn Bálor, who kicked Gunther below the belt.
 This allowed KO to hit the Stunner, gaining the victory.
 After the match, Sami Zayn blindsided Owens with a Helluva Kick
